gen-gf-chivo-mono-gf-lexend-mega: Typewriter precision meets glass-tube curves. Chivo Mono sets hefty letters in fixed-width steps, while Lexend Mega bends smooth, single-nib curves with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-gf-lexend-peta: Precise and technical up top, Chivo Mono spaces its hefty lowercase out like typewriter keys. And Lexend Peta follows with marker-like curves that never thin, its big x-height giving the pair a sturdy, friendly footing.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta reads wide and tall-bodied, every stroke a cut ribbon. Chivo Mono brings hefty, typewriter-spaced letters with little stroke contrast, and the two lay out a page that feels measured.
gen-gf-chivo-mono-gf-montserrat-alternat: Contemporary, with Chivo Mono spacing hefty typewriter letters generously apart. But Montserrat Alternates keeps a steady stroke and round forms that crowd toward the capital line, so a stretch of it reads compact and sturdy.
gen-gf-coda-author: Author reads dignified, its bowls swelling slightly, best in compact bursts. Coda is the loud one, wide-mouthed round letters with pressed-thin diagonals, while Author quietly does the refined work.
gen-gf-coda-gf-hepta-slab: Coda opens wide and round, bold and expressive from the first letter. Where Coda performs, Hepta Slab holds steady, its constant-walled rings and breathing counters spreading each word wide.
gen-gf-coda-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads loose and editorial, its terminals stopping well short of the stem with generous letterspace. And Coda brings the strongest quality, bold, inviting round letters that stand out against that twine-like body.
gen-gf-coda-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Coda throws its round, wide-mouthed letters out with real swagger. Padyakke Expanded One strings its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, round bowls with walls that never swell, and that wide spacing is the memorable part.
gen-gf-coda-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Wide, inviting openings on round letters mark Coda as the expressive voice. Stint Ultra Expanded, across many lines, floats each pipe-cleaner character apart with open counters, so text reads slow, traditional and authoritative.
gen-gf-comic-neue-archivo: Comic Neue writes in a loose, friendly hand, with open curves and rope-thin strokes. But Archivo stands taller beside it, with a commanding x-height, so the two feel like a casual note next to an editorial page.
